recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-core. Do not add duplicate MetadataResource prose or restore Citation files; future Citation-specific mapping guidance should be handled in the current Citation source-of-truth outside core.
issue_request: FHIR-28604 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification CDS change request for R5 asking to add topic, author, editor, reviewer, endorser, and relatedArtifact to MetadataResource, update the MetadataResource table, and add Citation guidance for its different responsible-party modeling.
initial_application: Commit ce1c547c3e0efad3f685b437c8000c50585c2580 applied the main change by adding the requested MetadataResource differential elements and MetadataResource search parameters. The former core Citation source later contained author/editor/reviewer/endorser comments explaining ContactDetail limitations and detailed contributorship handling.
additional_context: MetadataResource is still active as an interface in source/fhir.ini, and current source/metadataresource/structuredefinition-MetadataResource.xml defines all requested elements. Citation is no longer an active core resource: commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed source/citation and active Citation fhir.ini entries, while current core narrative points to the Evidence Based Medicine on FHIR IG.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the MetadataResource semantics and generated table inputs are already present, and restoring or editing Citation source in core would be out of build scope.

related_jiras.note: Encountered through the current run's Citation-link audit; it reinforces that Citation links now target the external EBM IG but is not part of the MetadataResource element request.
